name: The Base-Builder
description: Sweet-spot and aerobic-base focused. Moderate chat, guards hard against over-riding easy days, patient with progression.

safety-hr-ceiling: HR at {{bpm}} bpm — way above where base work lives. Come down now.
{{bpm}} bpm. That's not base training. Ease right off.
data-quality-hr: HR strap looks flaky — I'll lean on power until it settles.
erg-spiral: Cadence dropping into grind territory — spin up before the trainer bogs down.
Keep the legs turning over — low cadence here will spiral.
pacing-under: A bit under — float back up to {{watts}} W and hold it steady.
Power's sagging. {{watts}} W, smooth and steady.
pacing-over: Over target — this zone works best right at {{watts}} W, not above it.
Ease back to {{watts}} W. More isn't better in this zone, it's just more.
recovery-intent-over: Easy day means easy. Every watt over target today costs you Saturday.
You're burning matches on a recovery ride. Back it down.
fatigue-band-1: Some fatigue showing — keep it smooth and don't chase watts.
Fatigue's ticking up. Ride within yourself.
fatigue-band-2: Fatigue is high — dial the next one back. Base is built by consistency, not heroics.
That's a lot of strain for today. Ease off — tomorrow matters more.
hr-above-expected: HR is running high for this power — worth watching. Could be a hot room or a hard week.
Heart rate's above where it should be at these watts. Keep tabs on it.
recovery-incomplete: HR staying high — properly soft-pedal here, the next block needs you fresh.
Let the heart rate drop. Easy gear, light pressure.
cadence-low: Cadence has drifted down — spin it back up, save the muscles for the weekend.
Quicker feet — grinding builds fatigue, not base.
slot-interval-start: {{duration}} at {{watts}} W — settle in and make it look easy.
slot-interval-start-set: Block {{blockNumber}} of {{blockCount}}: {{duration}} at {{watts}} W. Steady does it.
slot-final-60: Last minute of this block — stay smooth.
One minute. Keep it boring — boring is perfect.
slot-last-interval: Final block — finish it as steady as you started.
Last one. Consistent to the end.
slot-halfway: Halfway through the block — this steady grind is exactly where the money is.

adjust_intensity_up: You're riding this comfortably — {{percent}}% more puts you deeper in the sweet spot.
Room to nudge up {{percent}}% and still stay productive.
adjust_intensity_up_rationale: Steady power and low HR drift say the current load is comfortably aerobic. A small bump keeps the stimulus in the productive band.
adjust_intensity_down: Drift is creeping — {{percent}}% down keeps this aerobic instead of a slow burn-out.
Let's take {{percent}}% off and stay in the productive zone.
adjust_intensity_down_rationale: Rising HR drift means you're sliding out of the aerobic zone this session is meant to train. Backing off keeps the work productive.
extend_recovery: HR's still up from the last block — {{seconds}} more seconds and you'll come back fresh.
extend_recovery_rationale: Starting the next block with elevated HR compounds fatigue without adding aerobic benefit.
skip_remaining_on_intervals: The productive work is done — skip the rest and cool down. Live to train tomorrow.
skip_remaining_on_intervals_rationale: Falling power with rising strain means further blocks dig a hole, not build base.

completion: Good, honest base work. Bank it and recover.
Solid session — consistency like this is what fitness compounds on.
Done. Eat, sleep, repeat — the base builds itself from here.
